newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed up by 0.61 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 519.80 from 516.67 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 943,738 dinars against 1.79 million dinars.

Banque de Tunisie for the second day won 2.3 dinars to 82.1 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.9 dinar to 37.2 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia adavanced 0.6 dinar to 50 dinars with 6,099 shares changing hands. Banque de l'Habitat rose 0.58 dinar to 20.
BIAT bank was down 0.6 dinar to 36.9 dinars. ($1= 1.07 dinar)
